title: The family {U -> X, Y -> X} of the formal glueing situation is refined by an fpqc covering
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter spaces-pushouts.tex (Pushouts of Algebraic Spaces)
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file spaces-pushouts.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Reduce to X affine by an etale cover; U is a finite union of affines; choose an affine W -> Y surjective over f^{-1}Z with V(J) the preimage of Z; the pro-etale localization lemma produces B -> B' whose points are exactly the generizations of V(J), and the composite Spec(B') -> X is flat because f is flat at all points of f^{-1}Z; then {Spec(B') -> X, U_1 -> X, ..., U_n -> X} is an fpqc covering by the recognition lemma.
